title: Book a library study room from the app
text:
This is the #1 request from the beta. Tomas says the testers asked for it in nearly every feedback round: groups agree on a time, then waste half an hour finding a room.

**Scope**

* Show free rooms at the Westbrook library for the group's agreed session time
* Book a room in one tap and add the booking to the session details
* Cancel or change a booking from the session screen

**Open questions**

* Does the library expose availability through an API or do we need a manual export? Maya is contacting the library this month.
* Maximum booking length and per-student limits

Priya has the first mockups for the booking sheet.
